overall_notes: Paper focuses on improving contextual faithfulness in Long-Form Question Answering using retrieval heads. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicates and missing model names. Paper uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE, MiniCheck, etc.) and human evaluation with clear protocols. LLMs are used both as generation models and as evaluators (ChatGPT for claim decomposition, MiniCheck for faithfulness evaluation).
